info.desc: Surfer Rosa is the first full-length album by the American alternative rock band Pixies, released in March 1988 on the British independent record label 4AD. The album's unusual and offbeat subject matter includes references to mutilation and voyeurism; this is augmented by experimental recording, low-fidelity production and a distinctive drum sound. Surfer Rosa contains many of the elements present in the Pixies' earlier output, including Spanish lyrics and references to Puerto Rico. Because of 4AD's independent status, distribution in the United States was handled by British label Rough Trade Records; however, it failed to chart in either the UK or .

podcast.body: Steve Albini produced *Surfer Rosa*, the first full-length studio album for the then-unknown Pixies in 1988. The album instantly established the band as pioneers of American indie music and was widely regarded as Album of the Year by many media outlets. Its sound was remarkably distinctive, being innovative, experimental, contagious, luminous, and raw in equal measure, and the band never achieved such a strong and thrilling sound again. "En 1988, Steve Albindli producería unos entonces desconocidos Pixies en el que sería su primilalbum largo de estudio, surferrosa."
